card.name: We/us after contact, tell, help
card.fires_on: The pronouns "we", "us" or "our" right after a verb like contact, tell, guide, improve or help. Mostly in website text addressing the reader.

modes.label: Contact us
modes.description: "us" after the word contact in site menus and notices.
modes.example: Persons with disabilities having difficulty accessing this information should contact<< us>> at: https://info.ahrq

modes.label: Tell/help we-us
modes.description: "we" or "us" after a verb in a question or heading.
modes.example: What Do Warm Marches Tell<< Us>> About the Date of the Final Spring Frost

modes.label: Site feedback
modes.description: "we" in website prompts asking how the site can help or improve.
modes.example: Did you find this article helpful? Yes No How can<< we>> improve this article?

card.plain: It lights up on "us" or "we" in website phrases like "contact us" or "what can we help you find".
